def abspath_from_cwd(p):
    return os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(p))


def missing_component(path):
    p = os.path.abspath(path)
    drive = Path(p).anchor or os.sep
    cur = drive.rstrip(os.sep) or os.sep
    parts = Path(p).parts
    start = 1 if parts and parts[0] == os.sep else 0
    cur = os.sep if p.startswith(os.sep) else os.getcwd()
    accum = cur.rstrip(os.sep)
    for comp in parts[start:]:
        accum = os.path.join(accum, comp) if accum else comp
        if not os.path.exists(accum):
            return accum
    return p


class State:
    def __init__(self):
        self.no_input = False
        self.working_dir = None
        self.notebook_dir = None
        self.version = False
        self.help = False


def need_value(args, i, flag, what="path"):
    if i + 1 >= len(args):
        if flag in ("-W", "--working-dir", "--notebook-dir"):
            raise ValueError(f"{flag} requires a path argument")
        raise ValueError(f"{flag}: expected string value but got \"EOL\" (<EOL>)")
    return args[i + 1]


def parse_global_value(st, flag, val):
    if flag == "--notebook-dir":

def split_long(tok):
    if tok.startswith("--") and "=" in tok:
        k, v = tok.split("=", 1)
        return k, v
    return tok, None

GLOBAL_VALUE = {"--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W"}
GLOBAL_BOOL = {"--no-input", "-h", "--help", "--version"}


def command_of(argv):
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        tok = argv[i]
        key, val = split_long(tok)
        if key in GLOBAL_VALUE:
            if val is None:
                i += 2
            else:
                i += 1
            continue
        if tok.startswith("-"):
            i += 1
            continue
        return tok, i
    return None, None


def error_for_unknown(command, flag):
    if flag == "-v" and command is None:
        return 'unknown flag -v, did you mean one of "-h", "-W"?'
    if command in ("list", "graph") and flag.startswith("--"):
        return f'unknown flag {flag}, did you mean "--tag"?'
    if command in ("list", "graph") and flag.startswith("-") and flag != "-":
        return f'unknown flag {flag[0:2]}, did you mean one of "-h", "-W", "-f", "-d", "-0", "-P", "-q", "-i", "-n", "-m", "-M", "-x", "-t", "-l", "-L", "-r", "-s", "-e"?'
    return f"unknown flag {flag}"


def parse_args(argv, command):
    st = State()
    positional = []
    graph_format = None

    value_flags_common = {
        "--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W",
        "-n", "--limit", "-m", "--match", "-M", "--match-strategy", "-x", "--exclude",
        "-t", "--tag", "--mention", "--mentioned-by", "-l", "--link-to", "--no-link-to",
        "-L", "--linked-by", "--no-linked-by", "--related", "--max-distance",
        "--created", "--created-before", "--created-after", "--modified", "--modified-before", "--modified-after",
        "-s", "--sort"
    }
    value_flags = set(value_flags_common)
    bool_flags = {"-h", "--help", "--version", "--no-input", "-i", "--interactive", "--orphan", "--tagless", "--missing-backlink", "-r", "--recursive"}

    if command == "index":
        bool_flags.update({"-f", "--force", "-v", "--verbose", "-q", "--quiet"})
    elif command == "new":
        value_flags.update({"-t", "--title", "--date", "-g", "--group", "--extra", "--template", "--id"})
        bool_flags.update({"-p", "--print-path", "-n", "--dry-run"})
        # in new, -n is dry-run, not value
        value_flags.discard("-n")
    elif command == "list":
        value_flags.update({"-f", "--format", "--header", "--footer", "-d", "--delimiter"})
        bool_flags.update({"-0", "--delimiter0", "-P", "--no-pager", "-q", "--quiet"})
    elif command == "graph":
        value_flags.update({"-f", "--format"})
        bool_flags.update({"-q", "--quiet"})
    elif command == "edit":
        bool_flags.update({"-f", "--force"})
    elif command == "tag list":
        value_flags = {"--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W", "-f", "--format", "--header", "--footer", "-d", "--delimiter", "-s", "--sort"}
        bool_flags = {"-h", "--help", "--version", "--no-input", "-0", "--delimiter0", "-P", "--no-pager", "-q", "--quiet"}
    elif command in ("init", "tag"):
        value_flags = {"--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W"}
        bool_flags = {"-h", "--help", "--version", "--no-input"}
    elif command is None:
        value_flags = {"--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W"}
        bool_flags = {"-h", "--help", "--version", "--no-input"}

    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        tok = argv[i]
        if tok == "--":
            positional.extend(argv[i+1:])
            break
        key, eqval = split_long(tok)
        if key in ("--help", "-h"):
            st.help = True; i += 1; continue
        if key == "--version":
            st.version = True; i += 1; continue
        if key == "--no-input":
            st.no_input = True; i += 1; continue
        if key in GLOBAL_VALUE:
            val = eqval
            if val is None:
                if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                    raise ValueError(f"{key} requires a path argument")
                val = argv[i+1]; i += 2
            else:
                i += 1
            parse_global_value(st, key, val)
            continue

        if tok.startswith("--"):
            if key in value_flags:
                val = eqval
                if val is None:
                    if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                        name = key
                        friendly = {"--format":"--format", "--title":"--title"}.get(name, name)
                        raise ValueError(f"{friendly}: expected string value but got \"EOL\" (<EOL>)")
                    val = argv[i+1]; i += 2
                else:
                    i += 1
                if key == "--format" and command == "graph":
                    graph_format = val
                if key == "--limit":
                    try: int(val)
                    except Exception: raise ValueError(f"--limit: expected a valid 64 bit int but got \"{val}\"")
                continue
            if key in bool_flags:
                if eqval is not None:
                    if eqval not in ("true", "1", "yes", "false", "0", "no"):
                        raise ValueError(f"{key}: bool value must be true, 1, yes, false, 0 or no but got \"{eqval}\"")
                i += 1; continue
            raise ValueError(error_for_unknown(command, key))

        if tok.startswith("-") and tok != "-":
            # exact short options and a small amount of clustered behaviour seen in Kong.
            if tok in value_flags:
                if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                    name = {"-f":"--format", "-t":"--title", "-W":"-W", "-n":"--limit"}.get(tok, tok)
                    if tok == "-W":
                        raise ValueError("-W requires a path argument")
                    if tok == "-n" and command in ("list", "graph", "edit"):
                        raise ValueError('--limit: expected string value but got "EOL" (<EOL>)')
                    raise ValueError(f"{name}: expected string value but got \"EOL\" (<EOL>)")
                val = argv[i+1]; i += 2
                if tok == "-f" and command == "graph":
                    graph_format = val
                if tok == "-n" and command in ("list", "graph", "edit"):
                    try: int(val)
                    except Exception: raise ValueError(f"--limit: expected a valid 64 bit int but got \"{val}\"")
                continue
            if tok in bool_flags:
                i += 1; continue
            if command in ("list", "graph") and tok.startswith("-0") and len(tok) > 2:
                # -0x => -0 followed by -x without a value
                if "-x" in value_flags and tok[2:] == "x":
                    raise ValueError("--exclude: unexpected EOL")
            raise ValueError(error_for_unknown(command, tok))

        positional.append(tok)
        i += 1

    return st, positional, graph_format


def find_notebook(start):
    p = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(start))
    # The original reports the requested path even if it does not exist, after warnings.
    cur = p
    while True:
        if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(cur, ".zk")):
            return cur
        parent = os.path.dirname(cur)
        if parent == cur:
            return None
        cur = parent


def open_notebook(st):
    if st.working_dir:
        start = abspath_from_cwd(st.working_dir)
        if not os.path.exists(start):
            miss = missing_component(start)
            warn(f"lstat {miss}: no such file or directory")
            warn(f"lstat {miss}: no such file or directory")

    else:
        start = os.getcwd()
    if st.notebook_dir:
        start = abspath_from_cwd(st.notebook_dir)
        if not os.path.exists(start):
            miss = missing_component(start)
            warn(f"lstat {miss}: no such file or directory")
            warn(f"lstat {miss}: no such file or directory")

    nb = find_notebook(start)
    if nb is None:
        return err(f"failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {start} or a parent directory")

    if os.path.exists(cfg):

        os.makedirs(os.path.join(nb, ".zk"), exist_ok=True)
        open(os.path.join(nb, ".zk", "notebook.db"), "a").close()
    except Exception:
        pass
    return err(FTS_ERROR)


def init_command(argv):
    try:
        st, positional, graph_format = parse_args(argv, "init")
    except ValueError as e:
        return err(str(e))
    if st.version:
        out("zk dev\n"); return 0
    if st.help:
        out(HELP["init"]); return 0
    if len(positional) > 1:
        return err(f"unexpected argument {positional[1]}")
    if not st.no_input:
        out(PROMPT_BYTES)
        return err("EOF")
    explicit = len(positional) == 1
    target = abspath_from_cwd(positional[0]) if explicit else os.getcwd()
    zkdir = os.path.join(target, ".zk")
    if explicit and os.path.isdir(zkdir):
        out("\n")
        return err(f"init: a notebook already exists in {target}")
    if os.path.exists(target) and not os.path.isdir(target):
        return err(f"init: mkdir {target}: not a directory")
    if os.path.isdir(zkdir):
        # init with no explicit directory in an existing notebook simply tries opening it.
        dummy = State(); dummy.notebook_dir = target
        return open_notebook(dummy)
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(zkdir, "templates"), exist_ok=True)
        with open(os.path.join(zkdir, "config.toml"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
        with open(os.path.join(zkdir, "templates", "default.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(DEFAULT_TEMPLATE)
        out("\n")
    except NotADirectoryError:
        return err(f"init: mkdir {target}: not a directory")
    except Exception as e:
        return err(f"init: {e}")
    dummy = State(); dummy.notebook_dir = target
    return open_notebook(dummy)


def generic_notebook_command(argv, command):
    try:
        st, positional, graph_format = parse_args(argv, command)
    except ValueError as e:
        return err(str(e))
    if st.version:
        out("zk dev\n"); return 0
    if st.help:
        out(HELP[command]); return 0
    if command == "index" and positional:
        return err(f"unexpected argument {positional[0]}")
    if command == "new" and len(positional) > 1:
        return err(f"unexpected argument {positional[1]}")
    if command == "graph":
        if graph_format is None:
            return err("missing flags: --format=STRING")
        if graph_format != "json":
            return err(f'--format must be one of "json" but got "{graph_format}"')
    return open_notebook(st)


def tag_command(argv):
    # Determine whether the tag subcommand "list" is present among non-flag arguments.
    # Global/path flag values are skipped sufficiently for the observed interface.
    nonflags = []
    skip = False
    value_flags = {"--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W", "-f", "--format", "--header", "--footer", "-d", "--delimiter", "-s", "--sort"}
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        tok = argv[i]
        key, eq = split_long(tok)
        if key in value_flags and eq is None:
            i += 2; continue
        if tok.startswith("-"):
            i += 1; continue
        nonflags.append(tok); i += 1
    if nonflags and nonflags[0] == "list":
        try:
            st, positional, gf = parse_args(argv, "tag list")
        except ValueError as e:
            return err(str(e))
        # positional will contain 'list'; ignore it for this command, but reject extras.
        extras = [p for p in positional if p != "list"]
        if extras:
            return err(f"unexpected argument {extras[0]}")
        if st.version:
            out("zk dev\n"); return 0
        if st.help:
            out(HELP["tag list"]); return 0
        return open_notebook(st)
    else:
        # Unknown explicit subcommands are parser errors; no subcommand tries to open notebook.
        if nonflags:
            return err(f"unexpected argument {nonflags[0]}")
        try:
            st, positional, gf = parse_args(argv, "tag")
        except ValueError as e:
            return err(str(e))
        if st.version:
            out("zk dev\n"); return 0
        if st.help:
            out(HELP["tag"]); return 0
        return open_notebook(st)


def main(argv):
    # First parse enough global options to discover the command.
    cmd, idx = command_of(argv)
    if cmd is None:
        try:
            st, positional, gf = parse_args(argv, None)
        except ValueError as e:
            return err(str(e))
        if st.version:
            out("zk dev\n"); return 0
        out(ROOT_HELP); return 0
    if cmd not in {"init", "index", "new", "list", "graph", "edit", "tag"}:
        # Still validate unknown flags before the command if any were supplied.
        return err(f"unexpected argument {cmd}")
    # Keep all arguments except the command token; parser accepts global flags anywhere.
    rest = argv[:idx] + argv[idx+1:]
    if cmd == "init":
        return init_command(rest)
    if cmd == "tag":
        return tag_command(rest)
    return generic_notebook_command(rest, cmd)

def abspath_from_cwd(p):
    return os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(p))


def missing_component(path):
    p = os.path.abspath(path)
    drive = Path(p).anchor or os.sep
    cur = drive.rstrip(os.sep) or os.sep
    parts = Path(p).parts
    start = 1 if parts and parts[0] == os.sep else 0
    cur = os.sep if p.startswith(os.sep) else os.getcwd()
    accum = cur.rstrip(os.sep)
    for comp in parts[start:]:
        accum = os.path.join(accum, comp) if accum else comp
        if not os.path.exists(accum):
            return accum
    return p


class State:
    def __init__(self):
        self.no_input = False
        self.working_dir = None
        self.notebook_dir = None
        self.version = False
        self.help = False


def need_value(args, i, flag, what="path"):
    if i + 1 >= len(args):
        if flag in ("-W", "--working-dir", "--notebook-dir"):
            raise ValueError(f"{flag} requires a path argument")
        raise ValueError(f"{flag}: expected string value but got \"EOL\" (<EOL>)")
    return args[i + 1]


def parse_global_value(st, flag, val):
    if flag == "--notebook-dir":
        st.notebook_dir = val
    elif flag in ("-W", "--working-dir"):
        st.working_dir = val


def split_long(tok):
    if tok.startswith("--") and "=" in tok:
        k, v = tok.split("=", 1)
        return k, v
    return tok, None

GLOBAL_VALUE = {"--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W"}
GLOBAL_BOOL = {"--no-input", "-h", "--help", "--version"}


def command_of(argv):
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        tok = argv[i]
        key, val = split_long(tok)
        if key in GLOBAL_VALUE:
            if val is None:
                i += 2
            else:
                i += 1
            continue
        if tok.startswith("-"):
            i += 1
            continue
        return tok, i
    return None, None


def error_for_unknown(command, flag):
    if flag == "-v" and command is None:
        return 'unknown flag -v, did you mean one of "-h", "-W"?'
    if command in ("list", "graph") and flag.startswith("--"):
        return f'unknown flag {flag}, did you mean "--tag"?'
    if command in ("list", "graph") and flag.startswith("-") and flag != "-":
        return f'unknown flag {flag[0:2]}, did you mean one of "-h", "-W", "-f", "-d", "-0", "-P", "-q", "-i", "-n", "-m", "-M", "-x", "-t", "-l", "-L", "-r", "-s", "-e"?'
    return f"unknown flag {flag}"


def parse_args(argv, command):
    st = State()
    positional = []
    graph_format = None

    value_flags_common = {
        "--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W",
        "-n", "--limit", "-m", "--match", "-M", "--match-strategy", "-x", "--exclude",
        "-t", "--tag", "--mention", "--mentioned-by", "-l", "--link-to", "--no-link-to",
        "-L", "--linked-by", "--no-linked-by", "--related", "--max-distance",
        "--created", "--created-before", "--created-after", "--modified", "--modified-before", "--modified-after",
        "-s", "--sort"
    }
    value_flags = set(value_flags_common)
    bool_flags = {"-h", "--help", "--version", "--no-input", "-i", "--interactive", "--orphan", "--tagless", "--missing-backlink", "-r", "--recursive"}

    if command == "index":
        bool_flags.update({"-f", "--force", "-v", "--verbose", "-q", "--quiet"})
    elif command == "new":
        value_flags.update({"-t", "--title", "--date", "-g", "--group", "--extra", "--template", "--id"})
        bool_flags.update({"-p", "--print-path", "-n", "--dry-run"})
        # in new, -n is dry-run, not value
        value_flags.discard("-n")
    elif command == "list":
        value_flags.update({"-f", "--format", "--header", "--footer", "-d", "--delimiter"})
        bool_flags.update({"-0", "--delimiter0", "-P", "--no-pager", "-q", "--quiet"})
    elif command == "graph":
        value_flags.update({"-f", "--format"})
        bool_flags.update({"-q", "--quiet"})
    elif command == "edit":
        bool_flags.update({"-f", "--force"})
    elif command == "tag list":
        value_flags = {"--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W", "-f", "--format", "--header", "--footer", "-d", "--delimiter", "-s", "--sort"}
        bool_flags = {"-h", "--help", "--version", "--no-input", "-0", "--delimiter0", "-P", "--no-pager", "-q", "--quiet"}
    elif command in ("init", "tag"):
        value_flags = {"--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W"}
        bool_flags = {"-h", "--help", "--version", "--no-input"}
    elif command is None:
        value_flags = {"--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W"}
        bool_flags = {"-h", "--help", "--version", "--no-input"}

    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        tok = argv[i]
        if tok == "--":
            positional.extend(argv[i+1:])
            break
        key, eqval = split_long(tok)
        if key in ("--help", "-h"):
            st.help = True; i += 1; continue
        if key == "--version":
            st.version = True; i += 1; continue
        if key == "--no-input":
            st.no_input = True; i += 1; continue
        if key in GLOBAL_VALUE:
            val = eqval
            if val is None:
                if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                    raise ValueError(f"{key} requires a path argument")
                val = argv[i+1]; i += 2
            else:
                i += 1
            parse_global_value(st, key, val)
            continue

        if tok.startswith("--"):
            if key in value_flags:
                val = eqval
                if val is None:
                    if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                        name = key
                        friendly = {"--format":"--format", "--title":"--title"}.get(name, name)
                        raise ValueError(f"{friendly}: expected string value but got \"EOL\" (<EOL>)")
                    val = argv[i+1]; i += 2
                else:
                    i += 1
                if key == "--format" and command == "graph":
                    graph_format = val
                if key == "--limit":
                    try: int(val)
                    except Exception: raise ValueError(f"--limit: expected a valid 64 bit int but got \"{val}\"")
                continue
            if key in bool_flags:
                if eqval is not None:
                    if eqval not in ("true", "1", "yes", "false", "0", "no"):
                        raise ValueError(f"{key}: bool value must be true, 1, yes, false, 0 or no but got \"{eqval}\"")
                i += 1; continue
            raise ValueError(error_for_unknown(command, key))

            # exact short options and a small amount of clustered behaviour seen in Kong.
            if tok in value_flags:

                        raise ValueError('--limit: expected string value but got "EOL" (<EOL>)')

                if tok == "-f" and command == "graph":
                    graph_format = val
                if tok == "-n" and command in ("list", "graph", "edit"):
                    try: int(val)
                    except Exception: raise ValueError(f"--limit: expected a valid 64 bit int but got \"{val}\"")

            if tok in bool_flags:
                i += 1; continue
            if command in ("list", "graph") and tok.startswith("-0") and len(tok) > 2:
                # -0x => -0 followed by -x without a value
                if "-x" in value_flags and tok[2:] == "x":
                    raise ValueError("--exclude: unexpected EOL")

        positional.append(tok)
        i += 1

def find_notebook(start):
    p = os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(start))
    # The original reports the requested path even if it does not exist, after warnings.
    cur = p
    while True:
        if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(cur, ".zk")):
            return cur
        parent = os.path.dirname(cur)
        if parent == cur:
            return None
        cur = parent


def open_notebook(st):
    if st.working_dir:
        start = abspath_from_cwd(st.working_dir)
        if not os.path.exists(start):
            miss = missing_component(start)
            warn(f"lstat {miss}: no such file or directory")
            warn(f"lstat {miss}: no such file or directory")
            warn(f"lstat {miss}: no such file or directory")
    else:
        start = os.getcwd()
    if st.notebook_dir:
        start = abspath_from_cwd(st.notebook_dir)
        if not os.path.exists(start):
            miss = missing_component(start)
            warn(f"lstat {miss}: no such file or directory")
            warn(f"lstat {miss}: no such file or directory")

    nb = find_notebook(start)
    if nb is None:
        return err(f"failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {start} or a parent directory")

    cfg = os.path.join(nb, ".zk", "config.toml")
    if os.path.exists(cfg):
        try:
            data = open(cfg, "r", encoding="utf-8").read()
        except Exception as e:
            return err(f"failed to open notebook: failed to read config: {e}")
        stripped = data.lstrip()
        if stripped and not (stripped.startswith("#") or stripped.startswith("[") or "=" in stripped.splitlines()[0]):
            return err("failed to open notebook: failed to read config: (1, 1): parsing error: keys cannot contain new lines")
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(nb, ".zk"), exist_ok=True)
        open(os.path.join(nb, ".zk", "notebook.db"), "a").close()
    except Exception:
        pass
    return err(FTS_ERROR)


def init_command(argv):
    try:
        st, positional, graph_format = parse_args(argv, "init")
    except ValueError as e:
        return err(str(e))
    if st.version:
        out("zk dev\n"); return 0
    if st.help:
        out(HELP["init"]); return 0
    if len(positional) > 1:
        return err(f"unexpected argument {positional[1]}")
    if not st.no_input:
        out(PROMPT_BYTES)
        return err("EOF")
    explicit = len(positional) == 1
    target = abspath_from_cwd(positional[0]) if explicit else os.getcwd()
    zkdir = os.path.join(target, ".zk")
    if explicit and os.path.isdir(zkdir):
        out("\n")
        return err(f"init: a notebook already exists in {target}")
    if os.path.exists(target) and not os.path.isdir(target):
        return err(f"init: mkdir {target}: not a directory")
    if os.path.isdir(zkdir):
        # init with no explicit directory in an existing notebook simply tries opening it.
        dummy = State(); dummy.notebook_dir = target
        return open_notebook(dummy)
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(zkdir, "templates"), exist_ok=True)
        with open(os.path.join(zkdir, "config.toml"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
        with open(os.path.join(zkdir, "templates", "default.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(DEFAULT_TEMPLATE)
        out("\n")
    except NotADirectoryError:
        return err(f"init: mkdir {target}: not a directory")
    except Exception as e:
        return err(f"init: {e}")
    dummy = State(); dummy.notebook_dir = target
    return open_notebook(dummy)


def generic_notebook_command(argv, command):
    try:
        st, positional, graph_format = parse_args(argv, command)
    except ValueError as e:
        return err(str(e))
    if st.version:
        out("zk dev\n"); return 0
    if st.help:
        out(HELP[command]); return 0
    if command == "index" and positional:
        return err(f"unexpected argument {positional[0]}")
    if command == "new" and len(positional) > 1:
        return err(f"unexpected argument {positional[1]}")
    if command == "graph":
        if graph_format is None:
            return err("missing flags: --format=STRING")
        if graph_format != "json":
            return err(f'--format must be one of "json" but got "{graph_format}"')
    return open_notebook(st)


def tag_command(argv):
    # Determine whether the tag subcommand "list" is present among non-flag arguments.
    # Global/path flag values are skipped sufficiently for the observed interface.
    nonflags = []
    skip = False
    value_flags = {"--notebook-dir", "--working-dir", "-W", "-f", "--format", "--header", "--footer", "-d", "--delimiter", "-s", "--sort"}
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        tok = argv[i]
        key, eq = split_long(tok)
        if key in value_flags and eq is None:
            i += 2; continue
        if tok.startswith("-"):
            i += 1; continue
        nonflags.append(tok); i += 1
    if nonflags and nonflags[0] == "list":
        try:
            st, positional, gf = parse_args(argv, "tag list")
        except ValueError as e:
            return err(str(e))
        # positional will contain 'list'; ignore it for this command, but reject extras.
        extras = [p for p in positional if p != "list"]
        if extras:
            return err(f"unexpected argument {extras[0]}")
        if st.version:
            out("zk dev\n"); return 0
        if st.help:
            out(HELP["tag list"]); return 0
        return open_notebook(st)
    else:
        # Unknown explicit subcommands are parser errors; no subcommand tries to open notebook.
        if nonflags:
            return err(f"unexpected argument {nonflags[0]}")
        try:
            st, positional, gf = parse_args(argv, "tag")
        except ValueError as e:
            return err(str(e))
        if st.version:
            out("zk dev\n"); return 0
        if st.help:
            out(HELP["tag"]); return 0
        return open_notebook(st)


def main(argv):
    # First parse enough global options to discover the command.
    cmd, idx = command_of(argv)
    if cmd is None:
        try:
            st, positional, gf = parse_args(argv, None)
        except ValueError as e:
            return err(str(e))
        if st.version:
            out("zk dev\n"); return 0
        out(ROOT_HELP); return 0
    if cmd not in {"init", "index", "new", "list", "graph", "edit", "tag"}:
        # Still validate unknown flags before the command if any were supplied.
        return err(f"unexpected argument {cmd}")
    # Keep all arguments except the command token; parser accepts global flags anywhere.
    rest = argv[:idx] + argv[idx+1:]
    if cmd == "init":
        return init_command(rest)
    if cmd == "tag":
        return tag_command(rest)
    return generic_notebook_command(rest, cmd)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
